estimate_qualification: User authorized estimation. 13.2..14.2mm is a design review allowance, not measured free length or a bound certified by the Sharp drawing. Do not stretch the tail or claim full installed reach.
contact_face: top contact (supplier 上接); folded tail copper faces up
physical_pin_map: socket terminal = 11 - panel terminal; pad10 SCLK at +X, pad1 VSSA/GND at -X; all 10 routed pad positions and nets verified on release 69ac2649
slot_from_step: STEP housing is a filled block except a 0.4mm-high mouth (seat+1.05..1.45, housing front Y3.07..3.97); no modelled stop. Insertion 2.7mm from housing front is read from supplier drawing section A-A (interpretation). Cable centre at mouth world Z23.045.
route_result: Pass after the screen plane was lowered 0.8mm (screen centre world Z34.51). Drop 4.079mm; with 2.7mm insertion, 13.2/13.7/14.2mm tails end their bends at 5.58/5.75/5.91mm (limit 6.0). If insertion is only ~1.9mm, 14.2mm reaches 6.16mm. Before the drop: fail (shortest route 6.18mm).
assembly: Release the screen pod for access, shape one back fold without twisting, copper upward, insert to the stop and push the drawer closed before final pod fastening. Panel has independent support.
